deliverables: Build a custom Skill scoped to one specific, repeatable task.
Implement an agent that utilizes the custom Skill within a multi-step loop (perceive -> reason -> act -> observe).
Integrate and actively call 1 to 2 MCP connectors within the agent workflow.
Chain the components into a single end-to-end workflow executing on real input without mocks.
Make at least two separate commits since Assessment 1, each created on its own branch and merged via its own PR.
Include proof of execution (a screenshot or short video recording) in the PR description.
Update BUILD_LOG.md with the date, time spent, approximate tokens used, and summary of what shipped.
Document one issue/failure encountered during development and the changes made to fix it.
Submit the link to the final Pull Request.
ambiguities: It is unspecified where the note regarding 'one thing that didn't work on the first try' should be documented (e.g., within the PR description, BUILD_LOG.md, or commit message).
It is unclear whether the submission requires linking the single final PR that merges into main, or links to both PRs created during the git discipline workflow.
definition_of_done: Done means submitting a Pull Request link for a functional, non-mock AI agent workflow built with a custom Skill, multi-step loop, and 1-2 active MCP connectors, backed by at least two merged branch commits, proof-of-run media, an updated BUILD_LOG.md, and documented troubleshooting notes.
